mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member_security (member_id, login_fail_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, 1, NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE login_fail_count = login_fail_count + 1, updated_at = NOW()
mapper.update: UPDATE member_security SET lock_count = lock_count + 1, -- 누적 잠금 횟수가 3회 이상이 되면 is_locked를 1로 전환 (완전 차단) is_locked = IF(lock_count + 1 >= 3, 1, 0), updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
UPDATE member_security SET login_fail_count = 0, lock_count = 0, is_locked = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM member_security WHERE member_id = #{memberId} AND ( -- ① 이미 누적 3회 이상 잠겨서 완전 차단된 경우 (is_locked = 1) is_locked = 1 OR -- ② 최근 30분 이내에 잠긴 적이 있는 경우 (locked_at IS NOT NULL AND locked_at > DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 MINUTE)) ) )
SELECT IFNULL( (SELECT login_fail_count FROM member_security WHERE member_id = #{memberId}), 0 )
